release_notes:
Fix Ready Messages log alignment and cap (follow-up to 1.0.72).

Alignment: body text now lands flush with the 'Ready Messages' heading. Root cause of the 1.0.72 misalignment: zeroing the left tab stop to 0 does not work in Tk's Text widget -- Tk only jumps to a tab stop that is strictly to the right of the current cursor position; at x=0 the stop at x=0 is skipped and the text falls through to the default 8-character tab interval (~56 px), which is why the bodies were still indented in 1.0.72. Fix: remove the leading tab character from every log line entirely. Bodies now start at x=0 of the Text widget with no tab at all, which is exactly flush with the 'Ready Messages' label above (both sit at x=0 of the card's inner frame). The canonical log-line format changes from '\tbody\t[ts]' to 'body\t[ts]'. _migrate_old_log_line is updated to normalize both old (\t-prefixed) and new (no-prefix) formats on load, so today's ready_log.txt written by 1.0.72 displays correctly without a rewrite.

Cap: no change to the 6-entry cap logic. The 4-entry display seen after updating to 1.0.72 was correct -- only 4 messages had been sent that day. The cap silently drops the oldest entry only when a 7th would be added.
